status: Source-reviewed target examples; no mdfmt implementation or full upstream oracle execution yet.
errorCaseScope: Deferred regex and installed-package extends errors specify first-release behavior only. Later releases must support these roadmap items; package resolution uses installed files, not npm fetching.
policy: Expected output specifies mdfmt behavior, not markdownlint-cli2 --fix output. All cases must be idempotent and preserve meaning except for explicitly authorized rule-prescribed edits such as MD026. Enabled MD013 supplies a prose wrapping target even when lint exceptions exempt the original line. expectedEffectiveConfig is the resolved rule object before rule defaults and per-line directives; cliOptions contains cli2 options separately. remainingRuleIds is a unique set after formatting, including warnings.

cases.rationale: MD026 is enabled by default; perform its prescribed fix despite the heading-text change.
A disabled rule must not cause punctuation removal.
The configured prohibited set excludes exclamation marks.
Custom punctuation can prohibit a character allowed by default.
Question marks are not in the default prohibited set.
The trailing semicolon belongs to an HTML entity and is exempt.
An empty prohibited set permits all trailing characters.
Default MD013 exempts the original final-token overrun, but the user requires safe prose reflow to the configured width anyway.

cases.rationale: The link fits alone, not after the prose. Preserve its syntax and trailing punctuation.
An indivisible link of exactly 60 characters fits; adjacent prose does not.
Preserve the 61-character link; strict source behavior reports it even on its own line.
Standalone links are exempt in non-strict source behavior.
The pinned source contradicts its docs: strict bypasses the standalone-link exemption.
Existing reference definitions are exempt even in strict mode; this does not authorize creating them.
Default mode exempts the source's final-token overrun from linting, but eligible prose still reflows to the configured target width; the indivisible token remains exempt.
Stern flags the wrappable source line, but exempts the resulting indivisible token line.
Strict mode reports the overlong indivisible token after safe wrapping.
